record.name: Magento (Adobe Commerce)
record.one_liner: Adobe Commerce (Magento) provides developer tools, APIs, webhooks, events, and App Builder for building out-of-process and in-process extensions and integrations.

auth.notes: Authentication uses Adobe Identity Management Service (IMS) or reusable patterns provided by Commerce SDKs and libraries.

access.notes: The fetched developer documentation describes extensibility and building apps, but does not explicitly detail the sign-up or credential acquisition flow for a first-time unaffiliated developer.

api_surface.notes: Supports REST endpoints, GraphQL (via API Mesh), webhooks, events, and App Builder SDKs.

mcp.notes: The pages do not mention the Model Context Protocol.

buildability.reasoning: Extensive developer documentation and tools (App Builder, SDKs) exist, but access and credential provisioning details are not fully specified on these pages.

evidence.claim: Adobe provides developers with software, tools, and services to customize and extend Adobe Commerce.
Adobe Commerce supports out-of-process extensibility using App Builder, App Management, APIs, events, and webhooks.
Webhooks enable developers to configure synchronous logic to execute calls to external systems when an Adobe Commerce event triggers, using REST endpoints like GET /V1/webhooks/supportedList.
Adobe Identity Management Service (IMS) manages authentication for the Admin UI SDK.
API Mesh allows developers to combine multiple data sources into a single, queryable GraphQL endpoint.
